results.title: Inference-Time Attention Steering for Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
results.snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving models couple a reasoning stage with a diffusion-based trajectory decoder, but do not give a direct way to redirect attention toward safety-critical actors at inference time without retraining. We studied a bounded additive pre-softmax attention bias on the visual tokens of detector localized traffic actors on Alpamayo-R1's Qwen3-VL backbone. It is applied as a fail open forward pre-hook with no weight changes. On 50 lane-change scenarios from the Physical AI World Model Synthetic dataset. results.snippet: This paper presents our system for the CHiPSAL 2026 shared task on multimodal hate speech and sentiment detection in Nepali memes. We address both subtasks: binary hate speech classification and three-class sentiment analysis. # 具身智能与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）前沿追踪报告（2024-2026）

**日期**：2026-11-12（UTC）  
**领域**：Embodied AI / Vision-Language-Action (VLA) / Robotics  
**检索源数量**：33 条（其中机器人 VLA 高相关性来源 8 条：[2][19][21][23][24][25][26][32]）  
**方法论**：frontier-watch（增量追踪）+ evidence-grading（证据分级）+ deep-research（广域探索与定向深潜）  
**核心约束**：本报告**仅引用**提供的 33 个编号来源 [1]-[33]；未被覆盖的公共知识（如 RT-2、OpenVLA、π0、GR-1、Diffusion Policy 等）一律标注 `> 待核实`，不编造引用。

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

**一句话增量判断**：在提供的 33 条证据中，仅 8 条涉及机器人 VLA，且均为 2024 年中至 2026 年中发布的 arXiv 预印本 [2][19][21][23][24][25][26][32]；> 待核实：缺乏 2024-2026 年核心会议（CoRL/RSS/ICRA/ICLR/NeurIPS）同行评审论文与 OpenVLA/π0/GR-1 等公认 SOTA 工作的直接证据，导致无法在本证据集上完成“架构演进与可复现 SOTA”的增量梳理。
